evidence.description: Accessing URLSession.shared as a default parameter

candidates.explanation: The component `Statistics` directly accesses `URLSession.shared` as a default parameter value for the `urlSession` argument in the `fetchAndUpdate` method, creating a hard-coded singleton dependency.
candidates.title: Direct Singleton Service Access

evidence.description: Access and mutation of state from an async context

candidates.explanation: The class `Statistics` contains multiple mutable instance properties (e.g., `treesPlanted`, `activeUsers`) that are accessed and modified from an `async` context (`fetchAndUpdate`) without any actor isolation or synchronization mechanism.
candidates.title: Shared Mutable Instance State Without Isolation

evidence.description: Concurrent access/mutation of state via the shared instance's method

candidates.explanation: The `Statistics` class provides a global `shared` instance, and its mutable instance properties are accessed and updated from multiple concurrency contexts (via the `async` method `fetchAndUpdate`) without isolation.
candidates.title: Unprotected Mutable Global or Static State
